# jotmd v0.0.4

This release refreshes the built-in theme gallery, improves full-background themes, and changes the default vault location.

## Highlights

- Choose from 11 bundled themes, including new Basic, Catppuccin Latte, Colorblind Dark, Colorblind Light, and Revdiff themes.
- Full-background themes now paint panes, borders, search, and popups consistently, including content with nested ANSI style resets.
- The default notes directory is now `~/vault` instead of `~/notes`.

If `notes_dir` was omitted from an existing configuration, either move the notes from `~/notes` to `~/vault` or explicitly set `notes_dir = "~/notes"` before upgrading.

## Theme compatibility

The bundled gallery no longer includes `blue-pencil`, `ember-ink`, `field-notes`, `highlighter`, `monokai`, `solarized-light`, or `tokyo-night`. The `gruvbox-dark` theme is now named `gruvbox`.

If one of these names is configured through `theme`, `JOTMD_THEME`, or `--theme`, choose another bundled theme or provide a custom TOML theme before upgrading.

## Installation

Upgrade with Homebrew:

```sh
brew upgrade gonfff/tap/jotmd
```
